readOnlyNodeModules.why: vitest 5 writes node_modules/.vitest-cache and node_modules/.vite-temp on every run, with no tool involved (seen in the install-unchanged check), so the subject's own runner cannot run against a read-only node_modules. The scratch mode here uses --scratch-dir with the writable install; js-jest-newsletter covers the read-only case.
